_note: Hand-authored fixture data for SYN-001. The result is not set here: the match itself is generated later (Tactician, task S-4). The forecast is the scripted weather of the match; Kit Man repeats it and never promises more.

environment.roof: covers every seat; the pitch is open

programme.item: The Lamplighters Store opens at the foot of the Main Stand (sector W1).
Two under-12 academy sides play a short exhibition game on the pitch.
Lumo, the club mascot (a lamplighter with a lantern and a long brass pole), greets families in the Lamplighters Stand and poses for photos at the Family Desk.
Club legend Desmond Ockley walks a lap of the pitch carrying the derby lantern, which is handed to the home captain before kick-off.
The amber light display starts in the Foundry End and spreads around the stadium.
The teams walk out to the club anthem, 'Light the Quay', sung by the whole stadium.
Handshakes, team photos and the coin toss.
Half-time (around this time): the academy under-14 side does a lap of honour after winning its regional tournament.

sponsor._note: Invented match sponsor (task L-0). Never alcohol, betting or tobacco: validate.py check 6 reads this text too. The prize goes to the winner of the half-time games in statseat.
sponsor.name: Quayspoke Cycles
sponsor.description: A Brackwater bicycle maker, founded in an old rope works on the quay. It builds city and cargo bikes and runs free repair mornings for the club's academy players.

prize.name: Lamplighters Store voucher
prize.description: A 50-euro voucher for the Lamplighters Store, the club shop at the foot of the Main Stand (sector W1).
prize.awarded_to: the winner of the half-time games in statseat
prize.how_to_claim: The winner sees the voucher in statseat and shows it at the store counter, on match day or within 30 days.

referee_panel_average._note: Average per game of the national referee panel last season, hand-set; used only as a reference point when describing a referee.
